title: Scaling Rectified Flow Transformers for High-Resolution Image Synthesis
layout_note: Panel (a), the overview, has three input branches (caption encoders at top-left, timestep at bottom-left, noised latent at top-right) converging on a lavender-framed stack of MM-DiT blocks, followed by a short output column; panel (b) at the right opens one MM-DiT block as two mirrored columns (c and x) that share one wide Attention box.
grouping: A lavender-tinted square frame around the stacked MM-DiT-Block 1...d in (a); panel (b) is unframed, its two mirrored columns bounded by long vertical bus lines; sub-captions '(a) Overview of all components.' and '(b) One MM-DiT block' under each panel.
shapes_depth: Flat rounded rectangles with thin outlines: pink for inputs and outputs (Caption, Timestep, Noised Latent, Output), lavender for learned layers (MLP, Linear, Modulation, block entries), pale green for parameter-free or encoding steps (Sinusoidal Encoding, Patching, Unpatching, SiLU, Layernorm, Mod, Attention); three green shades for CLIP-G/14, CLIP-L/14 and T5 XXL. Variables are pink filled circles (y, c, x, alpha..zeta); operators are pale pink circles (+, *, concatenation). Optional RMS-Norm boxes are small dashed rounded rectangles. The text conditioning is drawn as a tensor: a rectangle split into coloured token blocks bracketed '77 + 77 tokens' and '4096 channel'.
proposed_highlight: The new block is named in italics (MM-DiT) and given half the figure as its own panel (b); no colour or marker singles it out.
lesson: Draw the conditioning tensor itself: fill its token blocks in the colours of the encoders that produced them and bracket its sizes (77 + 77 tokens, 4096 channel), so the reader sees how the text embeddings are concatenated and padded.
notes: Venue written as arXiv: the arXiv v1 first page states no venue; the candidate list gives ICML 2024 (unverified). year = arXiv preprint year. id uses the architecture name MM-DiT from the sub-caption; the paper's title names no model. flow 'mixed': (a) runs top to bottom with side inputs, (b) top to bottom in two columns. The figure is vector-drawn (no embedded images).

arrangement.units: two side-by-side panels with sub-captions: (a) overview with a lavender frame around the MM-DiT block stack, (b) one MM-DiT block, unframed, two mirrored columns between outer bus lines
arrangement.inputs_as: pink rounded boxes 'Caption' and 'Noised Latent' at the top and 'Timestep' at the bottom-left of (a); pink circles c, x, y entering (b) from the top
arrangement.shared: panel (b) is one MM-DiT block of (a)'s stack, tied only by name; inside (b) the two streams share one Attention box

taxonomy.task: text-to-image latent generation with a transformer whose text and image tokens keep separate weights and meet in joint attention (rectified-flow training)

insights.structure: An overview panel with the block stack framed in lavender sits beside a full-height panel that opens one block as two mirrored columns meeting at one wide Attention box.
insights.data: Text conditioning is drawn as a coloured token tensor with bracketed sizes, while the image latent, timestep and per-stream modulation parameters are pink circles.
insights.emphasis: The MM-DiT block gets half the figure as its own panel and an italic name; fill colour encodes layer kind, not novelty.
insights.flow: Both panels read top to bottom; in (a) the pooled vector y runs on a left bus with a branch into each block, and in (b) the modulation parameters arrive from long outer buses on dashed side arrows.
insights.avoid: In (b) the Q/K/V concatenation lines cross between the two columns and the alpha..zeta parameters ride long outer buses, and in (a) the CLIP-G/14 wires curve across one another to reach the pooled vector and the token tensor.

core.what: two mirrored columns, text stream c on the left and image stream x on the right, each with its own Layernorm, Mod and Linear, converge through concatenation circles on one wide shared Attention box and split again below it

relations.form: in (b) Q, K and V of both columns are concatenated in pale pink circles and enter a single Attention box that spans both columns
in (b) the text and image streams are identical mirrored columns of Layernorm, Mod, Linear, MLP with their own modulation parameters
panel (b) opens one MM-DiT block of (a)'s framed stack, tied to it only by the name MM-DiT and the matching c, x, y circles
in (a) the caption fans out to three encoder boxes whose outputs converge as coloured token blocks in one bracketed tensor and as a pooled vector
the timestep embedding and the pooled text vector meet at a + circle to form y, which runs on a left bus with a branch into each block and into Modulation
the transformer depth is drawn as MM-DiT-Block 1, 2, ..., d stacked inside one lavender frame

channels.colour: pink = inputs, outputs and variables (boxes and filled circles); lavender = learned layers (Linear, MLP, Modulation, block entries); pale green = parameter-free or encoding steps (norms, SiLU, Patching, Attention); the three encoder greens double as the identity of each encoder's token block in the tensor - a second meaning on the green family
channels.shape: rounded rectangles = layers, filled circles = variables, pale circles = operators, a split rectangle with brackets = the token tensor
channels.line: solid arrows = data flow; dashed short arrows in (b) = modulation parameters entering a Mod box; dashed box outline = optional RMS-Norm
channels.frame: lavender frame = the repeated block stack in (a)

quality.strengths: The joint attention is visible as geometry in (b): two identical columns converge on one Attention box twice their width and diverge below it; the text conditioning is drawn as a tensor with token blocks coloured by their encoder and bracketed sizes; the new block gets a full-height panel of its own.
quality.weaknesses: Wiring is long and crossing: the Q/K/V concatenation lines cross between the columns, the alpha..zeta parameters arrive from outer buses that run the full panel height, and the CLIP-G/14 wires in (a) curve across each other; the zoom from (a)'s stack to (b) is tied only by name; green fills mean both 'parameter-free op' and 'which encoder'.

measured.source: computed: paperfig kb measure (non-white pixels of a <= 800 px thumbnail, white = min(R,G,B) >= 245, minus the embedded images recorded by `refs crop` (images_px; their share is photo_share, null without a record); chromatic (RGB spread > 20) and neutral pixels clustered separately by PIL median-cut + k-means (k=8 / 3); clusters within dE00 4 merged; kept if >= 0.02 of chromatic pixels / neutral ones if >= 0.03 of all non-white pixels; share = fraction of the non-photo non-white pixels)
